title: Till Guidance on the Amount Spent Above the Least the Customer Must Spend
content:
The amount spent above the least the customer must spend, on a sale taking credit under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes, is measured as this guidance directs, and only while the credit has longer than a month left to run.

## The guidance

Where the least the customer must spend stands above the credit still available and the credit has longer than a month left to run, the amount spent above the least the customer must spend is the price of the new piece less the least the customer must spend, and never less than nothing. Where the least the customer must spend stands at or below the credit still available and the credit has longer than a month left to run, it is the price of the new piece less the credit still available, and never less than nothing. Otherwise nothing is added for spending above the least the customer must spend.

The time the credit has left to run is counted in whole months from the handling date to the last day the credit may be spent, as the registration records it; the credit has longer than a month left to run where that count exceeds one month.

## Both sides

| The least the customer must spend against the credit still available | Months the credit has left to run | The amount is measured as |
|---|---|---|
| above the credit still available | more than 1 | the price of the new piece less the least the customer must spend |
| at or below the credit still available | more than 1 | the price of the new piece less the credit still available |
| either | 1 or fewer | nothing |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

A price of the new piece of 12000 USD, a credit still available of 4000 USD, and three months left to run.

- The least the customer must spend is 9000 USD, above the 4000 USD still available: 12000 less 9000, which is 3000 USD.
- The least the customer must spend is 3500 USD, at or below the 4000 USD still available: 12000 less 4000, which is 8000 USD.
- The same figures but with one month or less left to run: nothing.
- The least the customer must spend is 13000 USD and the price of the new piece 12000 USD, with three months left: 12000 less 13000 is below nothing, so the amount is nothing.
